execution.result: Replaced tabbed Stops/Lines search with universal search showing both sections simultaneously, ordered by MiniSearch relevance score. Modified useFuzzySearch hook to return { items, topScore }.

Added exact route match boost in home-search.tsx: when query exactly matches a route shortName (case-insensitive), Lines section is boosted to appear above Stops. Extracted hasExactRouteMatch as a testable utility. Added vitest with 8 passing tests.
